usage: vibe kits second-brain [-h]
                              {install,diff,doctor,uninstall,enable-hook} ...

positional arguments:
  {install,diff,doctor,uninstall,enable-hook}
    install             Install or update the second-brain kit
    diff                Show file-level differences for managed files
    doctor              Check second-brain kit installation status
    uninstall           Remove files managed by this kit
    enable-hook         Enable proactive context wiring (SessionStart hook +
                        persona section) for Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor,
                        and OpenCode

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
